integrity: The numerical value 1/2 is credited as prior work. The proposed contribution is the full optimizer characterization, basis rigidity and count. The proof is self-contained; finite tests only supplement it. No independent audit was performed.
scientific_limitations: Characterizes minimizers for the axis-aligned cube and matching integer lattice, and their simultaneous affine images. Does not cover unmatched lattices, other norms, arbitrary periodic triangulations or symmetry-orbit counts. Historical priority risk persists for equivalent integer-matrix formulations.
title: Cube-optimal Kuhn frames are oriented spanning trees
